narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On February 27, 2024, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] assisted the Kent County Sheriff's Office with a traffic stop on US-131 near Wyoming, Michigan. The driver did not have a license, and the deputy asked for Border Patrol assistance with identification.
Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] interviewed the subject in Spanish. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no documents that allow him to be in the United States.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that in November 2020 he paid a smuggler in Reynosa, who hid him and four other people inside the trailer of a tractor-trailer that was driven across the Pharr International Bridge without the trailer being opened or inspected. He was let out at a warehouse in Pharr, Texas, later that night.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Warrant of Arrest and Notice to Appear.
